planned_searches.query: TITLE-ABS-KEY((ammonia OR NH3) AND (marine OR ship* OR vessel) AND ("fuel cell" OR SOFC OR engine) AND (efficiency OR emission* OR "techno-econom*"))
TS=((ammonia OR methanol OR LOHC OR "liquid hydrogen") AND (marine OR maritime) AND (superstructure OR "process synthesis" OR optimi*ation))
("ammonia cracking" OR "ammonia decomposition") AND ("membrane reactor" OR "packed bed") AND hydrogen
암모니아 AND (선박 OR 해양) AND (연료전지 OR 개질 OR 추진)
nitrous oxide ammonia fuel life cycle GHG intensity

inclusion_criteria: Reports a numeric operating condition, performance figure or emission factor for a unit in the superstructure
Marine application, or a land-based study whose conditions transfer with a stated argument
Published 2000 or later. Foundational work is included on the same terms as recent work: the kinetics, the first direct-ammonia cells and the ORC fluid screens are what later studies argue against.
exclusion_criteria: Duplicate reporting of the same underlying dataset
Fuel or unit outside the declared decision space

screening.note: Abstracts read is the count actually opened and judged, not the shortlist size. The remaining included records are unread and must not be cited.
screening.retrieval_note: Abstracts retrieved is what the fetcher actually holds, not what was asked for. 5,125 records were queued and 1,366 came back with text; the rest have no abstract in OpenAlex or Crossref and would have to be opened as PDFs. The earlier figure of 283 was the ceiling on citations, not the size of the search: the per-node caps were 30 in the fetcher and 400 in the screener's export, and both were the real limit.

screening_revisions: The first rule required a carrier or a marine context in the title, which discarded unit-level papers such as an anode-recycle ejector or an ORC fluid screen. Widening it to accept a narrow unit on its own moved S5 from 10 to 63 and S10 from 21 to 137.

Bare permeability, selectivity, purification and psa matched prostate markers, chorioamniotic membranes, clay liners and aspen veneer. Every S3 term now carries its own gas-separation context, and geoscience, construction and clinical families were added to the off-domain rules.

screening_revisions.defect: Reading the included set showed the title screen was passing whole families of off-domain work. Aspen the tree survived as the Aspen simulator, soybean nodule ammonia permeability as a carrier study, earthquake ground motion as gas purification, and bench catalysis for dyes and hydrogen peroxide as reforming.
screening_revisions.fix: The simulator now has to be named in full. Three families were added (plant and wood, fine chemical synthesis, aerospace), the geoscience family was split so that CO2 reservoirs and blast furnace gas stay in scope while earthquakes and plywood do not, and six families were made decisive: on-domain vocabulary can no longer rescue a record that trips them. Two process nodes used to overrule any off-domain hit, which is what let these through.
screening_revisions.effect: Title stage moved little, because only 1,531 of 36,173 records carry an abstract and the giveaway words are in the abstract. At the abstract stage the same rules removed 32 of 258 retrieved records, including every one of the twelve false positives found by hand.
